name: Text
description: Applies the 11/12/15/24 type ladder to any text element, without hand-rolling font rules.

type.description: The step on the type ladder; a step owns size, line height, weight and tracking. caption and control 11, body 12, code 12 mono, title 15 strong, display 24 strong, section-label 11 strong in tertiary ink.

color.description: Ink. accent is the accent's text ink for one word inside a line; success/warning/danger are for a run of text that carries a state on its own — prefer Badge or Alert when the state deserves a container.

strong.description: The strong weight on any role. A section's header is body in the strong weight, never a bigger step.

tabularNums.description: Tabular figures, so digits align and an updating number does not jitter

when: Any text that should sit on the type scale
Headings and paragraphs that need real tags
Text that must truncate or clamp
whenNot: A block of code (use CodeBlock); an inline digest is type="code"
guidelines: Pick the tag with as, the look with type — they are separate decisions
Never skip heading levels to get a smaller heading
A section header is body plus strong, never a bigger step
Color is for hierarchy and state, not decoration
Truncated text needs the full string in title or a tooltip
accessibility: as keeps the document outline intact for screen readers
Clamped text still exposes its full content to assistive tech

examples.name: Ladder
examples.code:
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack gap="sm">
  <Text as="h1" type="display">Two findings block the merge</Text>
  <Text as="h2" type="title">Pull request 412</Text>
  <Text as="p">Two token files changed since the last approval.</Text>
  <Text type="caption" color="tertiary">Checked 2 minutes ago</Text>
</Stack>

examples.name: Strong

propsSummary: type: caption|control|body|title|display|code|section-label - the step on the type ladder (default body)
color: primary|secondary|tertiary|accent|success|warning|danger - ink (accent = accent text ink; semantic inks for inline state)
